info.title: PER Middleware API
info.description: Sign a challenge with a pre-attested key instead of generating a fresh TDX quote on every call.

get.description: On first call, generates an ed25519 keypair, requests one TDX quote binding that keypair's public key, and caches both for the process lifetime. Every call (including the first) signs `challenge` with the cached signing key and returns that quote alongside the signature, so a caller only needs to verify the quote once and can then trust subsequent signatures from the same `pubkey` without re-attesting. Does not require a fresh TDX guest call after the first invocation, so it is faster than `/quote` for repeated verification.

parameters.name: challenge
parameters.description: Base64-encoded, exactly 64 bytes, signed with the attested key.

pubkey.description: Base64-encoded ed25519 public key of the attested signing key bound into the quote.

challenge.description: The base64-encoded challenge that was signed, echoed back.

signature.description: Base64-encoded ed25519 signature over the raw challenge bytes, produced by `pubkey`.

reportDataSha256.description: Base64-encoded SHA-256 of the 64-byte TDX report data (user data) bound into the quote.

500.description: Internal server error, e.g. `challenge` does not decode to exactly 64 bytes, or no TDX guest device present on first call
